description.zh: 加速域名，仅支持启用单个。
description.en: The accelerated domain name to enable. You can enable only one domain name per request.

descriptions.zh:
- 如果您的域名处于非法状态或域名对应账户欠费，您将无法正常调用该接口启用加速域名。
- 单用户调用频率：30次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- You cannot call this operation if the domain name is invalid or the associated account has an overdue payment.

- The call frequency for a single user is 30 calls per second.
